lines.japanese: はあ……。
lines.english: Sigh...

lines.japanese: 小鳩のために署名を集められなかった……。
lines.english: I couldn't collect the signatures for Kobato...

lines.japanese: もはや俺は屑だ。
lines.english: I was garbage.

lines.japanese: この世で最もいらないものと言えばなんだろう。
lines.english: What was the most worthless thing in the world?

lines.japanese: 基本的に、この世のすべては何かの役に立つべく存在していると思ってきた俺だが、森里君のロン毛と署名を集められなかった俺の二つだけは、もはや擁護ができない。特に森里君のロン毛。
lines.english: I had always believed that everything in this world existed to serve some purpose, but there was no defending either Morisato's long hair or me after I failed to collect those signatures. Especially Morisato's long hair.

lines.japanese: もういいや人生。
lines.english: I was done with life.

lines.japanese: 今までありがとう、終のおまえ。
lines.english: Thank you for everything, Final You.

lines.japanese: そして永遠にアデュー。
lines.english: And adieu forever.

lines.japanese: 今の俺は鷹でも鷲でも隼でもない……そしてカッコウですらない。
lines.english: I was no hawk, eagle, or falcon now... I wasn't even a cuckoo.

lines.japanese: つまり不格好ってことだね。
lines.english: In other words, I was looking pretty fowl.

lines.japanese: 俺は己のギャグに耐えかね、布団の中でのたうち回った。もう帰りたい。
lines.english: Unable to endure my own joke, I writhed beneath the covers. I wanted to go home.

lines.japanese: 帰りたい？　馬鹿を言うな、ここが俺の家じゃないか。
lines.english: Go home? Don't be stupid. This *was* my home.

lines.japanese: いや……あるよ。俺が帰れる場所はもう一つあるよ。
lines.english: No... There was somewhere else. One other place I could go home to.

lines.japanese: ああ、そうか……そうだね……。
lines.english: Oh, of course... That's right...

lines.japanese: 奈落の番人たる彼は言っていた。いつでも戻ってきていいんだと。
lines.english: The warden of the abyss had said so. I could come back whenever I wished.

lines.japanese: ああ、もう何も迷うことはないじゃないか。
lines.english: Then there was no reason to hesitate anymore.

lines.japanese: さあ往こう、すべてが叶う夢の深淵へ……。
lines.english: Come. Let us depart for the dream abyss where every wish comes true...

lines.japanese: おやすみ世界。ここからは夢物語（フィクション）だ。
lines.english: Good night, world. From here on, the story is fiction.

lines.japanese: 「くきーっ！　私のぱね田君を奪うなんて、何よあのどこから見ても完璧で、非の打ち所がない女！」
lines.english: “Grrr! How dare that flawless, faultless woman steal my Paneda away from me!”

lines.japanese: ん？　なんだ？
lines.english: Hm? What was that?

lines.japanese: 「べっ、べつに私はアイツが誰と結婚したって悔しくなんかないわよ！　あとで泣きついてきたって知らないんだからねっ！」
lines.english: “D-don't get the wrong idea! I don't care who he marries! And if he comes crying to me afterward, I won't help him!”

lines.japanese: この声は……ああ、そうだ。思いだした。
lines.english: That voice... Oh, right. I remembered now.

lines.japanese: 「まー、お似合いの二人ですし、ちょっぴり寂しくなりますけど、ここまできたら祝福してあげましょう。胸が高鳴るー」
lines.english: “Well, they make a perfect couple. It'll be a little lonely, but now that they've come this far, we should give them our blessing. My heart is pounding!”

lines.japanese: そうか、俺は結婚式の途中だったんだ。
lines.english: Of course. I was in the middle of my wedding.

lines.japanese: 「俺は小鳩と結婚するところだったんだ！」
lines.english: “I was about to marry Kobato!”

lines.japanese: 「ずっと一緒だよ、お兄ちゃん！」
lines.english: “We'll be together forever, Big Brother!”

lines.japanese: 「みんなーっ、今日は俺のためにありがとう！」
lines.english: “Thank you all for coming here today for me!”

lines.japanese: そうだ。そういえばこの前なんやかんやあって、４人の花嫁候補が俺と結婚するために争うこととなり、この絶海の孤島へ来たんだった。
lines.english: Right. Some stuff had happened earlier, and four potential brides had started fighting for the chance to marry me, bringing us to this lonely island far out at sea.

lines.japanese: そしてなんやかんやの末に、俺は駄候補どもを蹴散らして、本命である小鳩と添いとげることが出来たんだった！
lines.english: Then, after some more stuff happened, I crushed the worthless candidates and won a life with Kobato, the woman I had wanted all along!

lines.japanese: 「私を選んでくれてありがとう、お兄ちゃん！」
lines.english: “Thank you for choosing me, Big Brother!”

lines.japanese: うほほーい！　夢テレビさいこーう！
lines.english: Woo-hoo! Dream TV was the best!

lines.japanese: 夢テレビ？　いやいや、夢テレビとか言うなよ。夢醒めちゃうだろ。
lines.english: Dream TV? Hey, don't call it Dream TV. You'll wake me up.

lines.japanese: ここは俺の楽園。なんだって思い通りなんだ。
lines.english: This was my paradise. Everything happened exactly as I wanted.

lines.japanese: 「ほんとぱね田だからって好き勝手やってくれるよね。てか、羽田君返せよ」
lines.english: “You really do whatever you want just because you're Paneda. Seriously, give Haneda back.”

lines.japanese: 生意気な渡らないさんだって、はい、この通り！
lines.english: Even sassy Miss Wata-don't became—behold!

lines.japanese: 「ほんとヨージ君だから好き勝手されても仕方ないよね。羽田君よりカッコいいし」
lines.english: “You're Youji, so I can't help letting you do whatever you want. You're cooler than Haneda anyway.”

lines.japanese: ありえねー！　すべてが俺の思い通りー！
lines.english: Unbelievable! Everything happened exactly as I wanted!

lines.japanese: 「まあ、相手がこばっちゃんじゃ諦めるしかないなあ。なにしろ全宇宙的美少女だもんね」
lines.english: “Well, if his partner's Kobacchan, I guess we have to give up. She's the most beautiful girl in the entire universe.”

lines.japanese: 「あまりの美しさに世界中から戦争や紛争がなくなったそうですよ」
lines.english: “I hear her beauty has put an end to every war and conflict in the world.”

lines.japanese: 「地球上の緑が年々回復してるのも、彼女の美しさが深く関連してるらしいですねー」
lines.english: “Apparently, her beauty is also deeply connected to the recovery of Earth's plant life year after year.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと待ったあー！」
lines.english: “Hold it right there!”

lines.japanese: 「だ、誰っ！？　この大宇宙マクロコスモスに生きとし生ける森羅万象すべてが祝福している、幸せな結婚式の邪魔をするのはっ！？」
lines.english: “Wh-who dares interrupt this joyous wedding, blessed by every living thing and every natural phenomenon in the great cosmic macrocosm?!”

lines.japanese: 「俺だあーっ！」
lines.english: “Me!”

lines.japanese: 「も、森里君……いくら俺のことが諦められないからって、まさか結婚式にまで乱入してくるとは」
lines.english: “M-Morisato... I knew you couldn't give me up, but I never thought you'd crash my wedding.”

lines.japanese: 「俺の羽田を他のやつに渡すなんて、耐えられねえんだよ！」
lines.english: “I can't stand the thought of giving my Haneda to somebody else!”

lines.japanese: 「そっ、そこまで俺のことを想ってくれていたなんて……嬉しいよ、森里君」
lines.english: “I-I had no idea you cared that much about me... I'm so happy, Morisato.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんな、花嫁がふたり……彼はいったいどっちを選ぶというの！？」
lines.english: “Two brides! Which one in the world will he choose?!”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ俺、どっちとも結婚するー」
lines.english: “Then I'll marry both of you!”

lines.japanese: 「その手があったか！」
lines.english: “Why didn't I think of that?!”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとうお兄ちゃん、私を選んでくれて……」
lines.english: “Thank you for choosing me, Big Brother...”

lines.japanese: 「俺も選んでくれて……」
lines.english: “And for choosing me...”

lines.japanese: 「これからは三人で手を取りあって生きていこう」
lines.english: “From now on, the three of us will join hands and make our way through life together.”

lines.japanese: 「わーい」
lines.english: “Yay!”

lines.japanese: 「わーい」
lines.english: “Yay!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、でもすみません、そろそろバイトの時間なので現実に戻ってきていただけますか」
lines.english: “Oh, I'm sorry, but it's nearly time for your shift, so could you please return to reality?”

lines.japanese: 「いやあ……ところが戻りたくても、ちょっと戻り方が分からないんだよねー」
lines.english: “Well... Funny story. I'd like to return, but I don't quite know how.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、それじゃ仕方ありませんねー。未来永劫、奈落の隅で膝を抱えて生きていきましょうかー」
lines.english: “Oh, then I suppose it can't be helped. Let's sit huddled in a corner of the abyss for all eternity.”

lines.japanese: 「やれやれ、こいつは参ったなあ！　はっはっはっは……」
lines.english: “Well, well. This is quite a pickle! Ha-ha-ha-ha...”

lines.japanese: 「あーあ……勇気を出して、自分の過去と向きあわなかったから……」
lines.english: “Oh, dear... All because you couldn't work up the courage to face your past...”

lines.japanese: 「はっはっは……」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha...”

lines.japanese: 【ＧＡＭＥ　ＯＶＥＲ】
lines.english: [GAME OVER]
